GET Order
NT8
Tradovate
Get order by ID NT8​

Returns the full details for one order by its NT8-assigned or caller-supplied ID.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/accounts/{account}/orders/{orderId}

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Path parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
account	string	Required	Name of account in NT8
orderId	string	Required	NT8-assigned order ID or the custom orderId supplied to Place Order.
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'



url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/accounts/Sim101/orders/492281fc515e431692da57d957cfebb6"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



try:

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Success field types​

Float fields accept whole or fractional JSON numbers. Nullable fields are marked below.

FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	true on success.
id, type, account, instrument, instrumentType	string	Current order ID, object type and instrument identity.
time, gtd	string	Order time and good-till date.
epoch	integer	Unix milliseconds.
name, ocoId, onBehalfOf	string	Order labels; may be empty.
clientId	integer	NT8 client ID.
orderType, orderState, orderAction, timeInForce	string	Order type, state, side and duration.
quantity, quantityChanged, filled	integer	Requested, changed and filled quantities.
limitPrice, limitPriceChanged, stopPrice, stopPriceChanged, averageFillPrice	float	Order prices.
fromEntrySignal	string or null	Associated entry signal.
hasOverfill, isBacktestOrder, isLimit, isLiveUntilCancelled	boolean	Order flags.
isLong, isShort, isMarket, isMarketIfTouched	boolean	Side and type flags.
isSimulatedStop, isStopLimit, isStopMarket, isTrackingConfigured, isTrackingEnabled	boolean	Stop and tracking flags.
userData	string	NT8 user-data XML.
ownerStrategy	object	Strategy metadata.
ownerStrategy.id, ownerStrategy.name, ownerStrategy.displayName	string or null	Null when no owning strategy is identified.
Platform nuances​
Order ID lookup​

CrossTrade first attempts to match the current NT8 order ID. If that is not found, it also asks NT8 to resolve the caller-supplied ID stored in the order's UserData XML under AutomatedTradingOrderId. This lets you query by the custom orderId you sent at placement even if NT8, the broker, or a prop firm later changes the live order ID.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API. The account and orderId path parameters are passed inside args. The orderId value may be either the current NT8 order ID or your custom placement ID.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "GetOrder",

  "args": {

    "account": "Sim101",

    "orderId": "492281fc515e431692da57d957cfebb6"

  }

}
